title: Duplicate future creation can orphan the first waiter
reasoning: create_result_future and create_bundle_future unconditionally overwrite the dict entry for a correlation id. If two waiters are registered for the same request or bundle id, the first Future remains pending but is no longer reachable from storage, so resolve_result_future/resolve_bundle_future can only complete the most recently created Future. This can hang the earlier caller and leak the orphaned Future.
reproduction: Call create_result_future('r1') twice, keep both returned futures, then call resolve_result_future('r1', result). The second future resolves and the first remains pending indefinitely.
recommendation: Make duplicate future registration explicit: either return the existing pending Future for the same id, reject duplicates with an exception, or complete/cancel the replaced Future before overwriting it. Mirror the chosen behavior for bundle futures.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for duplicate request_id or bundle_id waiter registration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests that call create_result_future and create_bundle_future twice with the same id and assert the first waiter is not left pending under the chosen contract.
minimumFixScope: Update duplicate handling in create_result_future and create_bundle_future, plus focused storage tests.
